name: sparáran na scillinge
text: sparáran na scillinge is the Irish name MacKillop records for the leprechaun variant known as the cluricaun. The form literally means purse of the shilling. The full record of the cluricaun tradition sits under the headword cluricaune.

attributes.attribute: Irish name for the cluricaun; pointer to cluricaune headword
